title: Open-source DWG/DXF evidence-to-work reconciliation
mode: Deeper/broader primary-source research and plan-only update
scope: Reconcile current open-source DWG/DXF project documentation and public issue evidence with existing local owners.
Separate parser, writer, preservation, projection, downstream-consumer, ACIS/AcDs, and native-acceptance evidence.
Refine implementation-ready routing without adding peer-dependent work, tests, fixtures, or validation frequency.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source web review plus local plan/source/test crosswalk
method.limitations: Public issue reports are not normative format evidence or reproductions of libdxfrw behavior. Peer README/manual/source pages are mutable unless pinned. Private/customer corpora cited by ACadRust were unavailable, and candidate fixes have no published reporter retest in the reviewed issue pages. No broad support claim is derived from documentation alone; ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG layout questions.

sources.revision: NEWS/manual/README pages reviewed 2026-10-18; exact binary not pinned or run
sources.observed: The July 2026 NEWS labels 0.14.1 beta and describes an R2004 writer. Project documentation differs on effective writer ceilings and warns about CRC/audit problems for later versions. The manual distinguishes stable, unstable, debugging and unhandled classes; NEWS states the modern AcDsPrototype_1b datastore remains incomplete and newer SAB extraction is not generally reliable. These are project-scope declarations, not a runtime qualification.

The report describes an AC1014 2D POLYLINE with VERTEX subclass markers ending at AcDbVertex and no AcDb2dVertex marker; ACadSharp reportedly leaves a placeholder and fails while building the document. No public source drawing/hash or normative grammar evidence is supplied.

sources.revision: Issues and candidate commit references reviewed 2026-10-18; no candidate build or private corpus run
sources.observed: #132 contains a synthetic DXF-to-DWG report separating raw-only custom class loss, group-430 color-book name/DBCOLOR linkage loss, and table/BLOCK_RECORD XDATA loss. Its maintainer-linked commit requests reporter retesting; no result is published. #133 reports orphan-owner reassignment/phantom geometry. #134 reports 70/351 private AC1032 corpus failures after stricter record bounds, 65 attributed to AcDbMLeaderObjectContextData; a candidate recovery commit and later downstream merge are references, not verified reporter retests.

sources.revision: Current driver documentation and mutable ezdxf documentation reviewed 2026-10-18; no runtime used
sources.observed: GDAL DXF is a geometry projection/tessellation route; its optional modern raw-ASM path exposes carrier bytes and transform rather than a B-rep. Its public known-issues document is an older snapshot, not a current full capability census. ezdxf documents ACIS inspection/limited manipulation and explicitly says its drawing add-on does not render ACIS or provide a 3D renderer.

sources.revision: Current project documentation pages reviewed 2026-10-18; no application run
sources.observed: FreeCAD documents a DWG-converter to DXF to selected-importer route, with distinct C++ and optional legacy Python DXF importers; stock DXF import does not read embedded ACIS/SAT solids. LibreCAD_3 documents opt-in read-only DWG import and separate write gates, making it a compatibility consumer policy rather than an independent codec result.

localOwners: ODA and Autodesk legacy grammar review
localCrosswalk.result: Use only as an adversarial parser shape. Do not infer VERTEX subtype from the parent or generalize a recovery rule to mesh/polyface child records.
Keep the three loss modes independent and reuse existing generated owners. Candidate peer commit and issue status do not prove current peer behavior or a local defect.
Never synthesize model-space ownership for unresolved explicit owners. Keep record bounds; only retain/skip when record boundary and graph-safety conditions are proven, otherwise fail enclosing read.

Pin exact artifact and operation; record requested/actual version, parser lineage, per-handle/owner disposition, projection/loss, independent result, and native result separately. No peer runtime is needed for routine slices.

assessment.planImpact: Reconciles current peer evidence with existing local findings and owners, sharpens test/readiness boundaries, and confirms that external retests or peer installations do not block the next local PAR-20/7G.3 output-semantics slice. No support status or implementation order changed.
